---
title: "Sprott J System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& z\\
\dot{y} &=& -y+z\\
\dot{z} &=& -x+ay+y^2
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.48$ and initial condition $(4,1,0)$.
